```{=html}
<section class="bms-learn-filter-panel" data-bms-learn-filters aria-label="Filter Learn lessons">
  <p class="visually-hidden">
    Select one or more difficulties and learning tracks. Lessons match any selection within a group and every group that has a selection.
  </p>

  <div class="bms-learn-filter-group">
    <p class="bms-learn-filter-label">Difficulty</p>
    <div class="bms-learn-filter-options" role="group" aria-label="Filter by difficulty">
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--difficulty" data-bms-filter-difficulty="Beginner" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Beginner</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--difficulty" data-bms-filter-difficulty="Intermediate" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Intermediate</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--difficulty" data-bms-filter-difficulty="Advanced" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Advanced</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="bms-learn-filter-group">
    <p class="bms-learn-filter-label">Learning track</p>
    <div class="bms-learn-filter-options" role="group" aria-label="Filter by learning track">
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--track" data-bms-filter-track="Doubling Cube" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Doubling Cube</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--track" data-bms-filter-track="Checker Play" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Checker Play</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--track" data-bms-filter-track="Opening Play" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Opening Play</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--track" data-bms-filter-track="Match Play" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Match Play</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--track" data-bms-filter-track="Endgames" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Endgames</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
      <button type="button" class="bms-learn-filter bms-learn-filter--track" data-bms-filter-track="Engines and Analysis" aria-pressed="false">
        <span>Engines and Analysis</span><span class="bms-learn-filter-count" aria-hidden="true">×0</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="bms-learn-filter-footer">
    <p class="bms-learn-result-count" aria-live="polite" data-bms-learn-result-count></p>
    <button type="button" class="bms-learn-clear" data-bms-learn-clear hidden>Reset filters</button>
  </div>
</section>
```

::: {#learn-lessons}
:::

```{=html}
<p class="bms-learn-empty" data-bms-learn-empty hidden>
  No lessons match the selected difficulty and learning track. Reset the filters to see every lesson.
</p>
```
